mapper.select: SELECT id, category, title, content, author_user_id, published_at, pinned, view_count, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_notice WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT n.id, n.category, n.title, n.content, n.author_user_id, u.name AS author_name, n.pinned, n.view_count, n.published_at, n.expires_at, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM tb_notice n LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = n.author_user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE n.id = #{id} AND n.deleted = 0

SELECT n.id, n.category, n.title, n.author_user_id, u.name AS author_name, n.pinned, n.view_count, n.published_at, n.expires_at, n.created_at FROM tb_notice n LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = n.author_user_id AND u.deleted = 0
ORDER BY n.pinned DESC, n.published_at DESC, n.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
